# Bellver Affiliates by MTG

> An independent, plain-words guide to the Bellver Card, a crypto-funded payment card (fund it with USDT or USDC, spend in any currency), written by MTG (Musa The Giant), a Bellver affiliate. It covers how the card works, every price and fee, the rewards program (one-time referral commissions and the 2x2 matrix monthly rewards with the $100 a month rule), step-by-step video tutorials and short explainer videos. It is not the official Bellver website.

Key facts (from Bellver's official price list and compensation plan, version 08/2026, Bellver's October 2026 update and its November 2026 presentation):

- Four card levels, one-time price, virtual or physical: Basic $99 or $290, Premium $270 or $450, Business $650 or $950, Gold $1,400 or $1,800 (Bellver's presentation, November 2026). Diamond, the top level, is not available to buy. No monthly or annual fee listed.
- Fees: 3.9% card top-up fee (added on top of the amount loaded: load $100 and $103.90 leaves the wallet), 1.75% per transaction, 2% ATM withdrawal.
- Physical card: Visa (ATM cash, costs more than the virtual card). Virtual card: Mastercard, usable the same day.
- Funds sit in the cardholder's own non-custodial Fireblocks wallet, protected by their private key.
- Most benefits: Gold ($250,000 daily and $20,000 per transaction limits, monthly rewards on up to 20 levels as stars grow), $1,400 virtual or $1,800 physical. Business and Gold are Special Edition cards with protected personal data; Basic and Premium are regulated cards to the European and U.S. standard.
- Referral commissions (one-time, on 4 levels, Bellver's figures for physical cards): Basic $25, $20, $10, $10; Premium $60, $30, $20, $10; Business $150, $100, $100, $100; Gold $500, $400, $200, $200. Without a card of your own: level 1 only.
- Bellver affiliate websites by MTG: your own copy of this guide with your name, photo, contact buttons and referral link, $100 one-time in USDT (BEP-20), paid only after you have tested it and are happy, free updates included: https://bellveraffiliates.com/#your-website
- Monthly rewards: 0.1% of completed top-ups in the cardholder's 2x2 matrix, for those holding Premium or higher with two direct Premium+ referrals, who load at least $100 onto their own card that month. Missing it three months in a row loses the matrix position. Rewards are never guaranteed.

Order link used on this site (MTG's referral link): https://app.bellvercards.com?ref=mtg
